Job Summary As a SOC Analyst, you will monitor, detect, analyze, investigate, and support remediation of cybersecurity events in accordance with established standard operating procedures. The role requires close collaboration with stakeholders, engineering teams, incident responders, and business units across a global operating environment.
About the Team
The Information Security organization helps protect Walmart s customers, associates, information assets, and technology environment. SOC Incident Management is a centralized security operations function responsible for monitoring, detecting, analyzing, investigating, escalating, and responding to security threats. Analysts work alongside security engineers, incident responders, threat intelligence teams, and other cybersecurity professionals to protect the organization s information assets and networks.
Key Responsibilities
Security Monitoring, Investigation Incident Response
  • Monitor, triage, analyze, investigate, and support remediation of cyber events using defined SOC procedures, playbooks, escalation paths, and service expectations.
  • Perform investigation across endpoint, network, email, identity, cloud, Windows, and Linux telemetry; correlate evidence across multiple data sources to determine scope, impact, root cause, and recommended actions.
  • Run approved commands, queries, scripts, and automation for assigned areas of work while maintaining appropriate operational controls and documentation.
  • Identify indicators of compromise, suspicious behaviors, attack patterns, and emerging risks; escalate confirmed or high-risk incidents to the appropriate response teams.
  • Communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders during troubleshooting and security events, providing timely status, findings, risk context, and recommended next steps.
Detection Engineering Continuous Improvement
  • Provide actionable input to improve alert logic, correlation rules, detection use cases, thresholds, enrichment, prioritization, and suppression of known false positives.
  • Identify opportunities for new risk detection based on investigation trends, threat intelligence, recurring incidents, control gaps, and observed attacker behavior.
  • Partner with engineering and platform teams to validate and operationalize detection improvements across SIEM, EDR, SOAR, email security, firewall, IPS, and cloud security tooling.
  • Capture investigation learnings, recurring patterns, root causes, and operational gaps; recommend measurable improvements to SOC processes, playbooks, documentation, and analyst workflows.
AI / Generative AI Responsibilities

Governance, Ethics Compliance

  • Experience with SOAR, email security, incident/case management, firewall, IPS, security correlation, detection use-case development, and deployment.

title: Salesforce QA Engineer (Implementation & AI QA)
tagsAndSkills: Salesforce QA,salesforce,Process Quality,Quality,Product Quality,Quality assurance,Artificial Intelligence,Process
jobDescription:
About Asymbl

Asymbl is the workforce orchestration company we bring together recruiting technology, digital labor strategy, and platform expertise to help businesses build and scale a hybrid workforce of human and digital talent. We're building a company where people and digital workers operate as one coordinated system, and where go-to-market execution is as intentional as the products we deliver.


About the Role

We're hiring an outcome-focused Implementation & AI QA Engineer who blends technical rigor with client-facing judgment. This isn't a script-and-log role you'll be the bridge between client expectations, AI-driven applications, and platform performance, owning the validation of Salesforce configurations, AI workflows (including Agentforce and digital workers), and custom integrations that drive real business outcomes.

You'll partner closely with clients, developers, business analysts, architects, and implementation teams translating business requirements into test strategy, flagging risk early, and making sure what ships is reliable and measurable.


Why Join Us?

You'll test and help shape some of the most advanced AI and Salesforce work being built today, working directly with clients and cross-functional teams in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment. We run on trust, continuous learning, and a bias to action every QA engineer here has a direct line to customer success.


Key Responsibilities

Client-Facing Quality & Implementation

  • Lead testing engagements directly with enterprise clients UAT, validation workshops, solution walkthroughs.
  • Translate client business processes into clear, measurable quality criteria and test scenarios.
  • Partner with implementation consultants, BAs, developers, and architects to confirm solutions meet agreed requirements.
  • Guide non-technical stakeholders through UAT and explain findings in plain business language.
  • Flag implementation risk early and recommend fixes before they become client-facing problems.

AI & Agentic Workflow Testing

  • Validate AI-driven solutions Agentforce agents, AI recruiting workflows, digital workers, and LLM-powered applications.
  • Test prompt performance, conversational logic, factual accuracy, context handling, edge cases, guardrails, and AI-to-human handoffs.
  • Stress-test AI behavior across positive, negative, ambiguous, and adversarial scenarios.
  • Catch hallucinations, inconsistent responses, and failure patterns, and work with engineering to close them.
  • Build and maintain AI evaluation datasets and regression scenarios to hold performance steady across releases.

Salesforce & Functional Testing

  • Run functional, regression, system, and end-to-end testing across Salesforce implementations.
  • Test Lightning Experience, Flows, Apex-driven functionality, custom components, and Salesforce Industries/OmniStudio where applicable.
  • Validate business processes across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and other Salesforce products.
  • Confirm data integrity and that system behavior matches business requirements.
  • Build test scenarios covering standard workflows, edge cases, and business-critical processes.

Integration & API Testing

  • Test integrations between Salesforce and third-party apps, middleware, APIs, and external systems.
  • Run REST/SOAP API testing and validate data flow between connected systems.
  • Use Postman or similar tools for API validation.
  • Validate data mapping, transformation, and error/failure handling across integrations.

Outcome-Based Test Strategy

  • Design and execute manual and automated test plans anchored to real business outcomes.
  • Build risk-based testing strategies that prioritize critical processes and customer impact.
  • Create reusable test scenarios and regression suites that scale with implementation and deployment.
  • Push testing beyond functional correctness into reliability, usability, adoption, and business impact.

Proactive Problem Solving

  • Investigate defects, bottlenecks, data issues, and logic failures down to root cause.
  • Work with developers, BAs, architects, and implementation teams on solutions not just defect logs.
  • Spot failure points before they hit clients.
  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of production issues when needed.

Defect & Lifecycle Management

  • Track and prioritize defects in JIRA or equivalent tools.
  • Document defects with clear repro steps, expected vs. actual results, severity, business impact, and evidence.
  • Drive defects through resolution with development teams, on timeline.
  • Verify fixes and run regression testing after resolution.

Continuous QA Improvement & Automation

  • Build and evolve QA standards, processes, templates, and best practices.
  • Identify what's worth automating repetitive, high-value test scenarios.
  • Build and maintain automated regression suites (Selenium, Playwright, Provar, or similar).
  • Improve QA efficiency through reusable test assets, automation, and CI/CD integration.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required

  • 3–5+ years in software QA, with hands-on Salesforce platform/implementation testing.
  • Experience testing Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Salesforce Industries, OmniStudio, or similar.
  • Strong functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and UAT testing experience.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills — comfortable running UAT and validation with business stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM applications, conversational AI, prompt testing, or AI-powered workflows; direct Agentforce experience is a strong plus.
  • A problem-solving mindset — able to break down complex processes, spot edge cases, and drive root-cause fixes.
  • Experience with JIRA or similar defect-tracking and test management tools.
  • Working knowledge of API and third-party integration testing, ideally with Postman.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings and risk clearly to both technical and business audiences.

Preferred

  • Direct experience testing Agentforce, digital workers, or generative AI solutions within Salesforce.
  • Experience with AI evaluation, prompt testing, conversational AI, or AI QA.
  • Automation experience with Selenium, Playwright, Provar, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with Salesforce Flow, Apex, LWC/custom components, or OmniStudio.
  • REST/SOAP API and integration testing experience.
  • Familiarity with data validation and basic SQL.
  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, AI Associate, or similar).
  • ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Level certification (Test Analyst or AI Testing track).
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
  • Experience with enterprise Salesforce implementations and complex integration environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Salesforce implementations ship with high quality and minimal production defects.
  • AI-powered workflows perform reliably, accurately, and consistently.
  • Clients trust the testing process and complete UAT with confidence.
  • Critical business and edge-case scenarios surface before deployment, not after.
  • QA processes get more automated, scalable, and efficient over time.
  • Testing translates directly into successful implementation, adoption, and measurable client outcomes.

Algorithm, Firmware Software Interface Architecture

System Level Power Architecture

  • Exposure to GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux), log aggregation and distributed tracing (Loki, ELK/OpenSearch, Jaeger/Tempo), cloud cost optimization (FinOps), and security/compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) in cloud-native environments

Education:

Experience:

Embedded Development & Tools

ML Model Integration

  • Experience with model conversion, quantization (INT8, FP16), runtime optimization.
  • Ability to read/modify model graphs and connect to inference APIs.

Connectivity & Peripherals
  • Working knowledge of BLE, Wi-Fi, LoRa, RS485 , USB, and CAN protocols.
  • Integration of camera modules , MIPI CSI , IMUs , and custom analog sensors .

DevOps for Embedded
  • Hands-on with GitLab/GitHub CI, Docker, and containerized embedded builds.
  • Build system expertise: CMake , Make , Bazel , or Yocto preferred.
  • Experience in automated firmware testing (HIL, unit, integration).

Preferred (Bonus) Skills
  • Familiarity with machine vision pipelines , ISP tuning , or video/audio codec integration .
  • Prior work on battery-operated devices , energy-aware scheduling , or deep sleep optimization .
  • Contributions to embedded ML open-source projects or model deployment tools.

Why Join Us?

At EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD , we go beyond firmware we re designing and deploying embedded intelligence on every device, from industrial gateways to smart consumer wearables.

Build and lead teams working on cutting-edge real-time firmware + ML integration . Work on full-stack embedded ML systems using the latest AI accelerators and embedded chipsets . Drive product-ready, scalable software platforms that power IoT, defense, medical , and consumer electronics .

EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD is a cutting-edge Electronics Product Design and Engineering firm specializing in embedded systems, IoT solutions, and high-performance hardware development. We are looking for a dynamic, energetic Lead / Staff Software Engineer to join our growing team in AI (Artificial Intelligence) group.   • Bachelor s degree in Computer Engineering / Software Engineering / Electronics / Computer Science or equivalent (Master s preferred).

  • Experience training and serving CV models (ResNet/EfficientNet, YOLO/RetinaNet, U-Net/nnU-Net, Vision Transformers), and familiarity with ASR/TTS pipelines (e.g., Whisper, torchaudio).
  • Practical knowledge of model optimization (ONNX/TensorRT, quantization), and data tooling (Pandas, NumPy, OpenCV, ffmpeg).
  • Proficiency with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking (MLflow/W&B), model registry, CI/CD, monitoring/logging (Prometheus/Grafana/Cloud Monitoring).
  • Strong grounding in evaluation methodology: metrics, ablation studies, error/bias analysis, and reproducible research practices.
  • Comfort with cloud storage, queues, and databases; experience integrating AI services into existing systems.
  • Computer vision: 2 years (Preferred)
  • Nice-to-Have:
    • Experience with multimodal (vision + workflows; Hugging Face ecosystem.
    • Knowledge of real-time/edge inference, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM.
    • Background in signal processing or audio engineering; speaker diarization, voice cloning ethics.
    • Experience in regulated domains with HITL workflows and documentation.
Main Job Duties
  • Model development and inference
    • Implement, fine-tune, and evaluate CV models (classification, detection, segmentation, tracking) using PyTorch/TensorFlow.
    • Build robust inference services (REST/JSON) with batching, streaming, and hardware acceleration (GPU, TensorRT/ONNX).
    • Train and adapt voice/ASR/TTS models and integrate with vision pipelines (multimodal workflows).
  • Data and evaluation
    • Own dataset lifecycle: collection, cleaning, labeling/specs, augmentation, and versioning.
    • Define metrics and test sets; run offline/online evaluations (accuracy, latency, throughput, calibration) and error analysis.
    • Develop data transformation and feature pipelines; maintain data quality checks and bias/fairness assessments.
  • Production engineering
    • Containerize and deploy models to cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) using Docker/Kubernetes/Cloud Run/ECS.
    • Implement CI/CD, experiment tracking, model registry, A/B canaries, rollout/rollback strategies.
    • Build monitoring for drift, performance, and cost; automate retraining or active learning loops.
  • Systems integration
    • Design APIs and modules, integrate with upstream/downstream systems, and ensure reliable contracts and observability.
    • Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams to turn requirements into measurable deliverables.
  • Performance and optimization
    • Optimize training/inference (quantization, pruning, distillation, mixed precision); leverage ONNX/TensorRT/torch.compile.
    • Profile and tune data loaders, GPU utilization, caching, and I/O.
  • Compliance and safety
    • Implement data governance, privacy, and security best practices; maintain audit trails and documentation.
    • Establish HITL workflows and guardrails for clinical or safety-critical contexts where applicable.

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) delivers the silicon, optics, and hardware platforms for Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products. We are looking for Trainers to design, deliver and measure training programs for NIAT teams, excluding instructors.

The role will train Program Operations, Success Coaches, Curriculum & Assessment, and Specialist Cluster teams, covering 16 of 40 cohorts.

The trainer will first identify the actual performance gap through data, recordings, tickets, audits and discussions with employees/managers. Based on the findings, the trainer will define what needs to be trained and create a detailed training brief for the Content Creator, who will decide how the content is delivered.

The role will conduct live remote training from Hyderabad and measure whether employees have actually changed their work practices after training.


The key responsibility is not just delivering training, but identifying the real problem and measuring whether the training solved it.


Key Responsibilities


  • Identify actual skill and performance gaps through classes, recorded calls, tickets, audit data, employee discussions and manager feedback.
  • Define training topics and learning outcomes based on identified gaps.
  • Prepare detailed briefs for Content Creators covering the problem, topic, expected outcome and real-life situations.
  • Deliver approximately 5 hours of live trainer-led training per month for assigned cohorts.
  • Cover the common NIAT standard followed by role-specific training.
  • Prepare case packs and enable managers to conduct 2 hours of practice sessions per month with their teams.
  • Brief managers and track whether the practice sessions are completed effectively.
  • Set up and monitor 1 hour of self-paced learning per person per month, based on individual gaps.
  • Conduct assessments after training to check whether employees can apply the learning in their actual work.
  • Provide additional training or intervention where employees do not clear the required assessment.
  • Conduct a 30-day post-training impact review using recordings, tickets, audit data and manager feedback.
  • Measure whether employee behaviour and work practices have actually improved after training.
  • Participate in impact review meetings and provide clear feedback on training effectiveness.
  • Decide the next intervention based on impact results and rework the training approach where required.
  • Create simple role-wise playbooks documenting effective processes and practices.
  • Manage training delivery within the defined capacity of approximately 5 teaching hours per day / 120 hours per month.
  • Use AI tools where they can improve efficiency, such as identifying common themes from recordings or creating initial case-study drafts.
  • Continuously improve training material based on feedback and real-world performance.

Who We're Looking For


  • Experience delivering training to adult learners on a regular basis.
  • Strong experience conducting virtual/video-based training and keeping remote participants engaged.
  • Experience training different types of teams, such as support, operations, customer success or similar functions.
  • Ability to adapt training based on the requirements of different roles and teams.
  • Experience measuring training effectiveness after the session, not just tracking attendance.
  • Ability to identify performance gaps independently using records, tickets, recordings, audits and data.
  • Experience modifying training material based on real-world feedback and performance.
  • Comfortable handling difficult conversations with parents, students, customers or employees, or training teams that handle such conversations.
  • Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of the complete training cycle – gap identification training assessment impact measurement improvement.

Good to Have


  • Experience conducting Train-the-Trainer (TTT) programs and certifying trainers.

title: Social Media, Performance Ads & AI Content Intern
jobDescription:
Role Description

We are looking for a creative, energetic, and highly skilled individual who is passionate about creating engaging digital-first video content.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of video editing, social media content, performance advertising, motion graphics, and AI-powered content creation.

You will work closely with our Brand, Content, Design, and Marketing teams to create high-impact videos for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Performance Marketing campaigns, Product Launches, and other digital platforms.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just know how to edit videos, but understands what makes people stop scrolling, watch, engage, and take action.



Job Description / Responsibilities


1. Video Editing & Content Creation


  • Edit engaging Reels, Shorts, social media videos,performance ads, product videos, and brand content.
  • Convert raw footage, product assets, images, and existing content into polished video creatives.
  • Create multiple versions and variations of videos for different campaigns and platforms.
  • Understand pacing, hooks, transitions, music, storytelling, and retention while editing.
  • Repurpose long-form content into engaging short-form videos.
  • Stay updated with trending editing styles, viral formats, transitions, and social media trends.

2. Performance Marketing Creatives


  • Create video advertisements designed specifically for Meta, YouTube, and other digital advertising platforms.
  • Understand the importance of the first 23 seconds / scroll-stopping hook in performance creatives.
  • Experiment with different hooks, opening frames,CTAs, pacing, text overlays, and video structures.
  • Create multiple creative variations for A/B testing.
  • Work with the marketing team to understand which creatives are performing and incorporate learnings into future edits.

3. Motion Graphics & Visual Effects


  • Create engaging text animations, typography, transitions, lower-thirds, call-outs, and motion graphics.
  • Have working knowledge of Adobe After Effects for creating dynamic visual elements.
  • Enhance product features and USPs using motion graphics and visual storytelling.
  • Create clean, premium, brand-consistent animations.

4. AI-Powered Video Creation


  • Experiment with AI-powered tools to enhance and speed up the video creation process.
  • Use tools such as Runway, Pika, Adobe AI tools, Kling, Higgsfield, or similar Generative AI platforms.
  • Explore AI for: Video generation, Image-to-video, Background generation/removal, AI visual effects, Voiceovers, Auto-captioning, Video enhancement, Creative experimentation.
  • Stay updated with emerging Generative AI tools and AI video trends.

5. Social Media Content


  • Understand content formats across Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Meta Ads, YouTube, and other digital platforms.
  • Create platform-specific edits in formats such as 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, and 16:9.
  • Understand trending audio, meme formats, visual trends, and fast-paced social media editing.
  • Help the team create fresh and culturally relevant content ideas.

6. Post-Production & Quality Control


  • Perform basic to intermediate color correction and color grading.
  • Ensure proper audio levels, music synchronization, sound effects, and clean sound design.
  • Maintain smooth transitions and professional finishing across videos.
  • Export videos in the correct resolution, aspect ratio, file size, and format for different platforms.
  • Ensure all videos follow brand guidelines and visual consistency.


Must-Have Skills


Social Media Editing: Strong understanding of Reels, Shorts, trending formats, hooks, pacing, and retention-based editing.

Video Editing: Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro or equivalent professional editing software.


After Effects: Basic to intermediate understanding of motion graphics, text animation, and visual effects


Performance Ad Editing: Basic understanding of how digital ads differ from regular social media videos.


AI Video Tools: Hands-on experimentation with Generative AI / AI-powered video or image tools.


Storytelling: Ability to turn raw footage and assets into a clear and engaging visual story.


Sound Design: Basic understanding of music selection, sound effects, audio synchronization, and audio balancing.


Creative Eye: Good sense of typography, composition, visual hierarchy, transitions, and aesthetics.


Speed & Adaptability: Ability to work on multiple creatives and adapt quickly based on feedback.


Good to have Skills:


  • Food, restaurant or FMCG content experience is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of Photoshop / Illustrator
  • AI image generation
  • Basic 3D / Blender / Cinema 4D knowledge
  • CGI / VFX experimentation
  • Product video editing
  • UGC-style advertisement editing
  • Meme/trend-based editing
  • Basic understanding of performance marketing metrics
  • Experience creating content for D2C, e-commerce or consumer brand

Key Software / Tools


Core: Adobe Premiere Pro | Adobe After Effects


Good to Know: Photoshop | Illustrator | DaVinci Resolve

AI / Gen AI: Runway | Pika | Kling | Higgsfield | Adobe AI Tools | Other emerging AI video platforms.


Who can Apply ?

  • Students pursuing Design, Animation, Film, Media, Communication, Advertising, or related fields
  • Self-taught video editors with a strong portfolio are also encouraged to apply.

A strong portfolio / show reel demonstrating editing skills is mandatory.

Portfolio Should Ideally Showcase:


  • Reels / Shorts
  • Performance ads
  • Motion graphics
  • Product videos
  • Social media content
  • AI-generated / AI-assisted videos
  • Before-and-after editing examples
  • Any experimental or trend-based video work


Most importantly, we are looking for someone who can combine editing skills, creativity, social media understanding, and AI experimentation to create videos that are not just visually good but engaging and performance-driven.

Graphic Designer Intern 3 Months


Company: InPrime Finserv
Department: Marketing
Duration: 3 Months
Experience: Fresher / 01 Year
Employment Type: Internship


About the Role


InPrime Finserv is looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer Intern to support the Marketing Team in creating engaging visual content for digital campaigns, social media, customer outreach, and internal communication.

The intern will get hands-on experience working on real-time marketing campaigns and brand communication.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create creative designs for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and other digital platforms.
  • Design social media posts, carousels, stories, reels covers and campaign creatives.
  • Create brochures, flyers, posters, standees, banners and other marketing collaterals.
  • Design creatives for marketing campaigns, contests, customer outreach and employee engagement.
  • Support events, canopy activities and field marketing with creative requirements.
  • Create and edit Reels, Shorts and other short-form videos.
  • Add basic motion graphics, text animations, transitions and subtitles.
  • Convert marketing briefs and ideas into visually appealing designs.
  • Ensure consistency with brand guidelines and visual identity.

Required Skills & Tools

  • Good understanding of graphic design, typography, colours and visual composition.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Working knowledge of Canva.
  • Basic knowledge of video editing using Filmora, Premiere Pro or After Effects.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design and video editing tools.
  • Ability to design for both digital and print.
  • Good attention to detail and ability to work within deadlines.
  • Willingness to learn and take creative feedback.

Preferred Skills

  • Understanding of social media trends and digital marketing creatives.
  • Basic knowledge of motion graphics and short-form video editing.
  • Experience with AI-based creative, image-generation and video-editing tools is an advantage.
  • Understanding of branding and marketing communication.

Eligibility

  • Students or recent graduates from Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, Animation or related fields.
  • Freshers and candidates with 01 year of relevant experience can apply.

Portfolio


Portfolio is mandatory.

Candidates should share relevant work such as:

  • Social media creatives
  • Posters / banners
  • Campaign designs
  • Branding projects
  • Illustrations
  • Reels / video edits
  • College or personal projects

Language Preference


Kannada, Hindi and English – good working proficiency preferred.

Ideal Candidate , kannada is mandatory.

jobDescription:
Location: Malad West, Mumbai
Work Mode: Work From Office
Internship Duration: 6 Months
Working Days: Monday to Friday
Working Hours: 10:00 AM 7:00 PM
PPO: Potential full-time opportunity based on performance


About the Role

We are looking for a curious, analytical, and detail-oriented AI/ML QA Intern who is excited about Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Voice AI, and Conversational AI.

This role is ideal for freshers or candidates with 3–6 months of relevant internship/project experience who want to build a career in AI Quality Assurance and AI Testing.

You will work closely with our AI/ML, product, and engineering teams to test AI-powered applications, evaluate model responses, identify edge cases, and ensure that AI systems deliver accurate, relevant, consistent, and reliable results.


Key Responsibilities

  • Test and evaluate GenAI and LLM-based applications across different use cases.
  • Perform Prompt Testing by creating different prompts and evaluating AI responses.
  • Evaluate responses for accuracy, relevance, consistency, context understanding, and hallucinations.
  • Test Conversational AI and Voice AI systems across normal, unexpected, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Design and execute test cases, test scenarios, and evaluation criteria for AI features.
  • Identify unexpected, incorrect, inconsistent, or low-quality AI/model outputs.
  • Perform functional, regression, exploratory, and edge-case testing.
  • Create and maintain test datasets and scenarios for AI evaluation.
  • Reproduce and document bugs/issues with clear steps and observations.
  • Work with AI/ML engineers and developers to investigate issues and improve product quality.
  • Maintain clear documentation of test results, findings, and AI evaluation outcomes.

Requirements

  • Fresher or 3–6 months of relevant internship/project experience.
  • Educational background in AI/ML, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
  • Good understanding of basic AI/ML and Generative AI concepts.
  • Basic knowledge of Python.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a testing mindset.
  • Genuine interest in LLMs, Prompt Testing, GenAI, Voice AI, and Conversational AI.
  • Ability to think creatively and identify unusual or unexpected test scenarios.
  • Good communication and documentation skills.
  • Knowledge of APIs, Postman, SQL, Git, or software testing concepts will be an added advantage.

What You Will Learn

  • Real-world GenAI and LLM testing
  • Prompt testing and AI response evaluation
  • Conversational AI and Voice AI testing
  • AI/model output validation
  • Test-case and evaluation-dataset creation
  • Functional, regression, exploratory, and edge-case testing
  • Working with AI/ML engineers and real-world AI products

PPO Opportunity

This is a 6-month paid internship with a potential Pre-Placement Offer (PPO).

Based on your performance, technical skills, learning ability, problem-solving approach, and overall contribution, the company may offer an opportunity to join as a full-time employee after successful completion of the internship.


Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is best suited for candidates who are genuinely interested in AI Testing / AI QA and enjoy experimenting with AI systems, finding edge cases, challenging model responses, and understanding why an AI system behaves the way it does.

If you are excited about GenAI, LLMs, Voice AI, and Conversational AI and want hands-on experience working on real-world AI products, we encourage you to apply.

title: Python Web Scraping, Data Operations & SEO Content Intern
jobDescription:
About Us

Marketplacenetwork is a technology team building and maintaining automated data pipelines, web scrapers, marketplace websites, and client automation systems across a range of industries including Australian RV/caravan marketplaces, freight logistics, and e-commerce. Alongside our development work, we run content and SEO programs for our marketplace websites, using AI tools to help plan, draft, and illustrate blog and web content at scale.


About the Role

We're looking for a Python Web Scraping, Data Operations & AI Content Intern to join our team on-site in Erode. Depending on your strengths, you'll work across three areas: building/maintaining Python scraping scripts, running the day-to-day data operations that keep our pipelines and datasets clean and reliable, and/or helping produce SEO content, AI-assisted blog posts, and AI-generated images for our marketplace websites. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants real, production-level experience rather than just theory.


Responsibilities


Web Scraping:

  • Write and maintain Python scripts to extract data from websites (Selenium, BeautifulSoup)
  • Adapt scrapers when target websites change their layout or structure

Data Operations:

  • Monitor scraper and pipeline runs, and flag or fix failures/errors
  • Clean, structure, and organize scraped data into spreadsheets and organized files
  • Run data quality checks spotting duplicates, missing fields, mismatched formats, and broken records
  • Prepare and update data in Excel/Google Sheets for team review and reporting
  • Track data volumes and pipeline health, and report issues to the team
  • Document scripts, data structures, and processes clearly so the team can rely on them

SEO & AI Content:

  • Research keywords and assist with on-page SEO improvements for our marketplace websites
  • Draft and refine blog posts and web content using AI writing tools, then edit for accuracy and tone
  • Generate supporting images for blog and web content using AI image generation tools
  • Proofread and format content before it goes live

What You'll Learn

  • Real-world web scraping using Python (Selenium, BeautifulSoup)
  • Data operations practices used on live production pipelines monitoring, cleaning, quality control, and reporting
  • Workflow automation tools (n8n) and how scraping, data, and content pipelines connect end to end
  • Practical on-page SEO techniques and AI-assisted content/image workflows used at scale

Requirements

  • Basic working knowledge of Python
  • Basic Excel skills (formulas, sorting/filtering, basic data handling)
  • Comfortable writing and editing content in English
  • Basic understanding of SEO concepts (or willingness to learn quickly)
  • Interest in using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, image generators) for content or data work
  • Willingness to learn new tools and ask questions
  • Comfortable working on-site in Erode for the duration of the internship
  • Attention to detail and reliability in completing assigned tasks

Nice to Have (not required)

  • Prior exposure to web scraping, data handling, blogging, or content marketing
  • Familiarity with Google Sheets, automation tools, or AI writing/image-generation tools
  • Basic knowledge of WordPress or similar content management systems

Duration & Compensation


This is a 3-month internship. It is unpaid to start; if the internship goes well and there's a good fit, a performance-based stipend can follow based on your contribution and progress.

We’re building a nationwide chain of AI & Robotics Skilling Centers and Makers Labs across India, built on a “Skilling to Incubating” model that takes learners from structured training into hands-on prototyping and, eventually, incubation. title: Executive Assistant To CEO (UK- Property Management)
jobDescription:
Executive Assistant to Managing Director - Operations & Project

Coordination


Location: Remote India

Type: Full-time
Salary: 50000 to 65000 per month ( for outstanding candidates can be higher than this )
Progression: Significant opportunity to develop into broader operational responsibilities as the group continues to grow


About the Company : We are a UK-based group of companies operating across:


  • Residential architecture
  • Structural engineering
  • Residential property management

Over the last few years, the group has grown to a team of more than 25 people, with most of our operational team working remotely from India.We place a strong emphasis on:


  • Clear systems and processes
  • Accountability
  • Operational efficiency
  • Automation
  • AI
  • Modern technology
  • Taking responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing individual actions
  • Our team uses platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, Trello, TeamGantt, Fireflies, Microsoft 365 and other integrated business systems.

As the group continues to grow, we are looking for an exceptionally capable Executive Assistant to work directly with the Managing Director and take responsibility for a wide range of administrative, operational and coordination tasks.


The Role


This is not simply a diary-management Executive Assistant position. We are looking for someone who can become the Managing Director's highly capable right hand. The role combines:


  • Executive assistance
  • Business administration
  • Task ownership
  • Basic project coordination
  • Follow-up and accountability
  • AI-assisted work
  • Basic property portfolio management
  • General operational support

A major part of your job will be taking tasks away from the Managing Director and making sure they actually get completed.


You may need to coordinate several other employees in order to achieve this.For example, you may be given an objective that requires input from accounts, IT and another department.


Your responsibility is not simply to send everyone an email.Your responsibility is to coordinate the actions, follow up where necessary, identify problems and ensure the required outcome is achieved.


We are looking for someone who understands the difference between:

I sent the reminder. and The task was completed.That distinction is extremely important to us.


1. Executive Support: You will help manage the Managing Director's day-to-day business workload. This may include:


  • Managing and organizing the calendar
  • Arranging meetings
  • Preparing information before meetings
  • Following up actions after meetings
  • Drafting emails and correspondence
  • Organising documents and information
  • Researching issues
  • Keeping track of commitments
  • Managing reminders and deadlines
  • Making appointments
  • Obtaining information from other employees
  • Dealing with routine matters without unnecessary escalation
  • Filtering administrative issues before they reach the Managing Director

The objective is to reduce the number of routine matters requiring Managing Director involvement.Where something can reasonably be handled by you, we expect you to take ownership of it.


2. Task Ownership and Follow-ThroughThis is one of the most important parts of the position.The Managing Director will regularly give you tasks or outcomes to achieve.Sometimes these will have clearly defined steps.Other times you may simply be told:Can you sort this out?You should be capable of:


  • Understanding what the required outcome is
  • Working out what needs to happen
  • Identifying who needs to be involved
  • Allocating or requesting actions from colleagues
  • Setting or confirming deadlines
  • Following up outstanding work
  • Checking that information has been received
  • Resolving straightforward problems
  • Identifying when something is going off track
  • Escalating genuinely important issues
  • Confirming that the final outcome has actually been achieved

We do not want someone who considers their responsibility complete simply because they have sent an email or reminder.We want someone who takes responsibility for getting the task over the finish line.


3. Project and Team CoordinationThe role includes basic project coordination.You do not need to be a professionally trained Project Manager and we are not looking for someone focused on complex project-management methodology.However, you should be comfortable coordinating tasks between several people.For example, the Managing Director may decide that the company needs to introduce a new process.You may then need to:


  • Identify the actions required
  • Work out which employees need to be involved
  • Create a simple action plan
  • Coordinate different team members
  • Keep track of deadlines
  • Follow up outstanding tasks
  • Identify delays
  • Make sure dependencies are dealt with
  • Keep the Managing Director informed where necessary
  • Confirm that the new process has actually been implemented

You should be capable of taking something from: Objective Actions Owners Follow-Up Completion Previous experience with project coordination would therefore be useful.


4. AI and Technology Strong practical AI skills are a core requirement for this role. We believe that a modern Executive Assistant should be capable of using AI to dramatically improve their productivity. You should already use, or be highly comfortable using, tools such as ChatGPT and Claude in your normal working life. You may use AI to help with:


  • Research
  • Drafting emails
  • Summarizing meetings
  • Analyzing transcripts
  • Organizing information
  • Comparing documents
  • Preparing reports
  • Creating checklists
  • Drafting procedures
  • Structuring unclear information
  • Researching unfamiliar subjects
  • Preparing meeting notes
  • Solving administrative problems
  • Improving existing processes

You do not need to be a programmer or AI engineer. However, candidates who have little practical experience with AI and little interest in becoming highly proficient with it are unlikely to be suitable. Equally, we do not want someone who blindly copies and pastes AI-generated answers. You must be capable of:


  • Giving AI clear instructions
  • Providing appropriate context
  • Reviewing outputs critically
  • Spotting mistakes
  • Improving the result
  • Using your own judgement

AI should make you more capable it should not replace your judgement.


5. Basic Property Portfolio Management: One of the companies within the group, CEB Properties, operates a very small UK residential property portfolio of approximately six properties.Part of your role will involve handling its routine day-to-day administration.


This is not a specialist property-management position, and the portfolio is deliberately small.


The company is building clear operating systems, workflows, checklists and procedures to make these tasks straightforward to manage.

Typical responsibilities may include:


  • Responding to routine tenant communication
  • Coordinating property viewings
  • Arranging maintenance
  • Contacting contractors
  • Following up repairs
  • Coordinating check-ins and check-outs
  • Organising referencing
  • Managing routine tenancy administration
  • Keeping property records organised
  • Monitoring safety and compliance deadlines
  • Arranging periodic inspections
  • Making sure routine property tasks are completed

Previous property-management or real-estate experience would be an advantage because you will already understand some of these processes. However, it is not essential


A capable and organized person should be able to learn this part of the role quickly using the systems provided.


6. Business Administration : You will take responsibility for a variety of routine business-administration tasks across the group.This may include:

  • Insurance renewals
  • Insurance claims administration
  • Obtaining quotations
  • Managing subscriptions
  • Supplier accounts
  • Routine business registrations
  • Organising company records
  • Renewing services
  • Basic purchasing
  • Booking appointments
  • Researching suppliers or services
  • Filling in forms
  • Following up third parties
  • Organising documents
  • Maintaining records
  • Updating trackers
  • Managing routine correspondence
  • Checking that recurring administrative tasks have been completed

We need someone who does not consider ordinary administrative work beneath them. At the same time, we want you to continually look for ways to make repetitive work easier.


You should naturally ask:


Can this be simplified?

Can AI help with this?

Can this be automated?

Can we create a template?

Can we create a checklist so we don't have to rethink this next time?


7. Follow-Up and Accountability Across the Team: Because we have a team of more than 20 people, the Managing Director cannot personally follow up every outstanding action. You will help create accountability. his may involve:


  • Following up department heads
  • Following up individual team members
  • Requesting updates
  • Checking deadlines
  • Identifying overdue actions
  • Confirming whether tasks have actually been completed
  • Organising information from several people
  • Highlighting problems
  • Escalating matters when genuinely necessary

You must therefore be comfortable politely but persistently following up colleagues, including people who may be more senior than you within their own department.


We are looking for somebody who is pleasant and professional but persistent.


8. Process Improvement: You do not need to be an operations Manager. However, we want someone who naturally likes organized ways of working. As you become familiar with the business, you may help:


  • Improve checklists
  • Create templates
  • Document recurring tasks
  • Improve simple procedures
  • Organise filing systems
  • Identify unnecessary administration
  • Improve trackers
  • Identify repetitive work that could be automated
  • Use AI to improve routine processes

The Managing Director and Operations team will develop many of the larger operating systems.


Your job will often be to work effectively within those systems and help improve them through practical experience.

The Person We Are Looking For


We are looking for someone who is:


  • Extremely organised
  • Highly proactive
  • Intelligent and quick to learn
  • Dependable
  • Persistent
  • Detail-oriented
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Comfortable coordinating other employees
  • Capable of managing several tasks simultaneously
  • Strong at following work through to completion
  • Confident communicating with department heads
  • Excellent in written and spoken English
  • Technically confident
  • Comfortable learning new software
  • Already comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude
  • Capable of researching unfamiliar subjects
  • Able to use common sense and judgement
  • Solutions-focused
  • Discreet and trustworthy
  • Comfortable carrying out basic administrative work

Most importantly, you should have a strong sense of ownership.

If you are given responsibility for something, we want you to think:I am responsible for making sure this gets done.Particularly

Relevant Experience


We would be particularly interested in candidates who have previously worked as:


  • Executive Assistant
  • Executive Assistant to Founder / CEO / Managing Director
  • Senior Executive Assistant
  • Founders Office Associate
  • Business Operations Associate
  • Operations Executive
  • Business Support Executive
  • Executive Operations Associate
  • Administrative Manager

Experience involving any of the following would also be particularly valuable:


  • Project coordination
  • Property management
  • Real estate
  • Business operations
  • Working with multiple departments
  • Process improvement
  • Startup or SME environments
  • Working directly with a founder or Managing Director
  • AI and automation

You do not need experience in every area. We are more interested in intelligence, ownership, organization, judgement and ability to learn quickly than in finding somebody whose previous job description exactly matches ours.


This Role Is Probably Not Right for You If

This position is unlikely to suit you if:


  • You require detailed instructions for every task
  • You are uncomfortable making straightforward decisions
  • You dislike chasing people for outstanding actions
  • You consider a task complete simply because you sent a reminder
  • You dislike basic administrative work
  • You prefer very narrowly defined responsibilities
  • You struggle to manage several different types of work
  • You are uncomfortable learning new technology
  • You rarely use AI and have little interest in becoming proficient with it
  • You regularly escalate straightforward problems rather than trying to solve them

What Success Looks Like


Within your first six months, we would expect you to have:


  • Taken control of a substantial amount of the Managing Director's routine administration
  • Reduced unnecessary interruptions to the Managing Director
  • Created a reliable system for managing follow-ups and outstanding actions
  • Successfully coordinated multiple tasks involving different employees
  • Taken responsibility for routine administration within the small property portfolio
  • Become confident managing its approximately six properties
  • Taken responsibility for routine business administration such as insurance, suppliers and renewals
  • Become highly proficient with the company's AI tools
  • Improved the organisation of important information and records
  • Assisted with several internal projects
  • Improved or documented recurring administrative processes
  • Demonstrated that when you are given an outcome to achieve, you can take responsibility for getting it completed

Development and Progression: This role has significant scope to develop.


As you become more capable and understand the business, you may progressively take responsibility for:


  • More complex internal projects
  • Wider operational coordination
  • Property operations
  • Business processes
  • Automation initiatives
  • Junior administrative support
  • Cross-departmental initiatives

We are a growing business and are looking for someone who wants to become a highly trusted and capable member of the management support team.


Application


Shortlisted candidates will be assessed primarily on practical capability rather than CV length or impressive job titles.

We are particularly interested in evidence of:


  • Strong practical AI use
  • Exceptional organisation
  • Task ownership
  • Follow-through
  • Problem solving
  • Basic project coordination
  • Clear written communication
  • Good business judgement
  • The ability to take an objective and get it completed

#AIEngineer #DataEngineering #SQL #Python #Snowflake #dbt #AgenticAI #DistributedSystems #SemanticLayer


About WALT


WALT (thewalt.ai) is building the world's first Autonomous Data Engineer: a platform of five specialised, collaborating AI agents (Ingestor, Transformer, Reasoner, Operator, and Governor) that manage an entire data platform end-to-end, covering ingestion, transformation, analytics, monitoring, and governance.


What makes WALT different is how it answers business questions. Instead of relying on an LLM to generate SQL on the fly, our Reasoner agent uses deterministic analytical inference over a Data Context Graph (ReasonBase), a context layer that maps business vocabulary to the underlying data. The result is the same trusted answer, every time. That reliability is why regulated, data-intensive customers in financial services, retail, and advertising trust us with their analytics: they get auditability, compliance, and consistency, not stochastic guesses.

We're an early-stage, fast-moving team obsessed with correctness, security, and delivering analytics people can actually rely on.


The Role


We're looking for an AI-native Senior Software Engineer to help build the data and analytical products at the core of WALT, the systems that turn raw, messy enterprise data into trusted, deterministic answers at scale.


This is a hands-on builder-and-coder role, not a purely advisory or architect one. You'll design, implement, and evaluate core components of how our agents reason over data, build the platform that makes that reasoning fast, correct, and governable, and go deep to prove out the hard parts in code. You'll be a strong individual contributor and a key technical voice as WALT scales, a force multiplier for the engineering team.


If you've spent your career building analytical and data products (semantic layers, query/inference engines, BI and analytics platforms, or large-scale data pipelines) and you want to build a category-defining product hands-on, this is for you.


What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and evaluate core components of WALT's analytical and data products: the context layer (ReasonBase), the deterministic inference engine, and the data platform the agents operate on.
  • Build systems that produce correct, reproducible, and auditable analytical results across large, heterogeneous enterprise datasets.
  • Contribute to the foundational technical decisions: data modelling and the semantic/knowledge graph, query and inference execution, storage and compute, orchestration across the agent framework, and the boundaries between neural and symbolic components.
  • Partner with FDEs and founding engineers to translate ambiguous customer problems across industries into robust, scalable implementations.
  • Uphold and raise engineering standards for performance, reliability, security, and compliance (auditability, lineage, governance).
  • Own critical services end-to-end, writing reference implementations and reviewing important code.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to design and code reviews as the team grows.

Core experience

  • 4+ years building production software, with meaningful time spent on data-intensive and analytical products (analytics/BI platforms, semantic layers, query or inference engines, data warehouses/lakes, or large-scale data pipelines).
  • A track record of owning and shipping complex components or services end-to-end, seen running in production, ideally at a data or product company (e.g., Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake).
  • Solid foundation in distributed systems and data engineering: data modelling, query processing, storage/compute trade-offs, and building for correctness and scale.
  • Strong grasp of the analytics stack: SQL and modern data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt), and orchestration.
  • Fluency in one or more backend languages used for data systems (e.g., Python, Java/Scala, Go, or Rust).
  • Ability to reason rigorously about data correctness, reproducibility, and auditability. You care that the answer is right and explainable, not just fast.
  • Hands-on experience (or strong, demonstrated interest) building with agentic AI: designing, orchestrating, and shipping systems built on LLM/agent frameworks and multiple collaborating agents.

How you work

  • Hands-on: you design by building and earn technical trust through code and prototypes.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and an early-stage pace. You empathise with customers and go deep to solve their real problems, turning a fuzzy need into shipped software rather than a slide.
  • A clear communicator who collaborates well and helps level up the engineers around you.

Nice to have

  • Experience with semantic layers, knowledge graphs, ontologies, or symbolic/rule-based reasoning.
  • Experience with ML/LLM systems (neuro-symbolic approaches); ability to train or fine-tune models.
  • Background delivering software into regulated or data-sensitive industries (financial services, retail/adtech, healthcare) with real compliance, governance, and security requirements.

Why WALT

  • Help build a genuinely new category, the autonomous data engineer, from an early and influential seat.
  • Work on hard, meaningful problems where correctness and trust are the product, not an afterthought.
  • Direct impact with enterprise customers in high-stakes, regulated domains.
  • A team that values reliability, security, and doing the hard engineering right.

Learn more at https://www.thewalt.ai

## What You Will Do

Own outbound prospecting across channels including:


* Cold calling

* Cold email

* LinkedIn outreach

Your objective is not simply to book meetings.


Your objective is to generate **qualified sales conversations and real business opportunities**.


Test Different ICPs and Markets


We will continuously test different industries and customer segments.


You will be responsible for:


* Researching industries and customer segments

* Identifying relevant companies and decision-makers

* Account research

* Segmentation

* Buying signals

* Trigger-based outreach

* Personalized messaging

* Calling prospects directly

* Understanding the prospect's business problem

* Message iteration

However, you should understand how to use AI to become significantly more effective at sales and business development.

Through outbound conversations and campaign data, you should also help us understand:


* Which industries have the strongest pain points

* Which decision-makers respond

* Buying triggers

Build a repeatable outbound engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline for the company.
